# Adhd

This folder contains the two primary course-based demographic cohorts tracked within the Danish ADHD-DATABASEN: the treatment population and the diagnostic population. These cohorts serve as the foundational denominators for national quality indicators, monitoring everything from clinical processes like medical treatment and psychoeducation to long-term societal outcomes such as primary school graduation rates. Together, they provide a comprehensive view of the ADHD care pathway in Denmark, from initial assessment through ongoing treatment.

## Pages

- [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]] — The national cohort of patients in ADHD treatment package courses, acting as the baseline for evaluating medical, educational, and therapeutic quality indicators.
- [[adhd-udredningspopulation|ADHD-udredningspopulation]] — The national cohort of individuals undergoing ADHD diagnostic assessments, used to measure early clinical processes and long-term educational achievements.
